  -- Fiscal year runs from 1 July to 30 June; fiscal year 2026 = 1 Jul 2025 to 30 Jun 2026.

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY fiscal_calendar AS
  FUNCTION year_of(p_date IN DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS
  BEGIN
    -- If month is July (7) or later, it belongs to the next fiscal year.
    -- Example: 2025-07-01 -> 2025 + 1 = 2026.
    -- Example: 2026-06-30 -> 2026 + 0 = 2026.
    RETURN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p_date) + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p_date) >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
  END year_of;

  FUNCTION quarter_of(p_date IN DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS
  BEGIN
    -- Fiscal quarters: Q1 (Jul-Sep), Q2 (Oct-Dec), Q3 (Jan-Mar), Q4 (Apr-Jun)
    -- July is month 7. (7 - 7) / 3 + 1 = 1.
    -- October is month 10. (10 - 7) / 3 + 1 = 2.
    -- January is month 1. (1 - 7 + 12) / 3 + 1 = 2 (Wait, Jan should be Q3).
    -- Let's use a more robust calculation for the fiscal quarter.
    -- Fiscal month index: July=1, Aug=2, ..., Dec=6, Jan=7, Feb=8, ..., Jun=12.
    -- Quarter = ceil(fiscal_month / 3)
    RETURN CEIL((MOD(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p_date) + 5, 12) + 1) / 3);
  END quarter_of;
END fiscal_calendar;
